events.title: Liberty Reserve emerges as a centralized digital-currency system

research.summary: US Justice Department records state that Liberty Reserve was incorporated in Costa Rica in 2006 and operated an internet digital-currency/payment system that later became widely used by cybercriminals.
research.significance: Liberty Reserve is useful pre-Bitcoin context for earlier centralized internet currencies and for understanding why decentralization, custody and law-enforcement resistance became important design questions.
